title: Build a Personal Portfolio Page
description: Create a single-page personal portfolio using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. This is your first step — make it count.
objectives: Learn basic HTML structure and semantic tags
Practice CSS layout with Flexbox or Grid
deliverables: A responsive portfolio page hosted on GitHub Pages or Netlify
At least 3 sections: About, Skills, Projects
requirements: Use a CSS reset or normalize.css
Push code to a public GitHub repository
tips: Keep the design simple and clean. Less is more.
Commit early and often — each commit tells a story.
Write a clear README.md so others understand your project.

title: Build a REST API with CRUD Operations
description: Build a RESTful API that supports full CRUD operations for a resource of your choice. This challenge bridges the gap between frontend and backend.
objectives: Understand REST principles and HTTP methods
Implement CRUD operations with proper status codes
Structure an Express.js application with routes and controllers
deliverables: A working Express.js API with at least one resource
All 5 CRUD endpoints: GET (all), GET (one), POST, PUT/PATCH, DELETE
A Postman collection or .http file for testing
requirements: Use Express.js (or your preferred Node framework)
Store data in-memory or in a JSON file — no database needed
Write a README with setup instructions and endpoint documentation
tips: Start with a simple in-memory array before adding any persistence.
Use Postman or Thunder Client to test each endpoint as you build it.
Separate your routes, controllers, and models for clean architecture.
Write meaningful commit messages — recruiters read your GitHub history.

title: Build a Real-Time Chat with WebSockets
description: Build a real-time chat application using WebSockets. Users should be able to join a room, send messages, and see messages from others instantly.
objectives: Understand the WebSocket protocol and when to use it
Implement a WebSocket server with Socket.io
Broadcast messages to connected clients in real time
deliverables: A simple frontend that connects and displays messages
requirements: Use Socket.io or the native ws package
Push to a public GitHub repo with a working README
tips: Test with multiple browser tabs to simulate multiple users.
Add a typing indicator for extra polish.

title: Ship a Full-Stack Mini Project
description: For your final challenge, ship a complete full-stack mini project that combines everything you have learned over 60 days.
objectives: Combine frontend, backend, and deployment skills
Build a project worthy of your portfolio
deliverables: A full-stack application with frontend and backend
Deployed to a public URL (Vercel, Netlify, Render, etc.)
A polished README with screenshots and setup instructions
requirements: Must have a working frontend and backend
Write a LinkedIn post reflecting on your 60-day journey

resources.title: How to Write a Great README

tips: Pick a project you are genuinely excited about — it shows in the final product.
Document your journey in your LinkedIn post. Authenticity wins.
